title: Drupal core release state comes from the official update feed
summary: The official Drupal update-status release-history feed exposes project status, supported branches, release versions, release types, and security coverage, so release-aware knowledge should watch that source instead of hard-coding the latest Drupal version.

drupal_core.notes: Release applicability must be derived from the current release-history source state.

actions: Use the official Drupal release-history feed as the watched source for Drupal core release state.
Do not encode today's latest Drupal version as a permanent knowledge fact.
checks: Compare observed project Drupal core versions against the current release-history source state before making release or support findings.
automation_hints: Future project analyzers can join composer.lock Drupal core versions with the watched release-history feed.

enforcement.rationale: This record governs release-state sourcing; project-specific findings require observed project versions and current feed evaluation.
